name: StockWallpapers 15
tagline: 在 iOS 15 的锁屏和主屏使用多代系统动态壁纸。
description: 在「壁纸库 15」按系列下载 iOS 18、26、27 的系统壁纸，选中款式后同时应用到锁屏和主屏。
提供 9 个系列、42 款壁纸。壁纸资源按需下载。
features: Space、Celosia、Duo 和 Fluidity 支持自动、浅色和深色外观。选择自动时跟随系统外观。
Duo 提供内屏与外屏两种构图。
compatibility: 支持 iOS 15，提供 Rootless 和 RootHide 版本。
iOS 16–18 请安装同源的「系统壁纸」。
usage: 按包管理器提示完成重载。打开主屏上的「壁纸库 15」，也可从「设置 → 系统壁纸 15」打开。
下载所需系列，再点选款式。若锁屏或主屏仍显示系统壁纸，请确认越狱环境已加载并重载 SpringBoard。
在库内点「恢复系统壁纸」可切回原壁纸。已安装 iOS 15 测试版可直接覆盖升级。

changes: 支持 iOS 15，壁纸库提供 9 个系列、42 款可下载壁纸，可同时应用到锁屏和主屏。
支持系列可选择自动、浅色或深色外观。Duo 可选择内屏或外屏构图。
修复打开和收起通知中心时闪回原壁纸、过渡色调异常的问题。

en.name: StockWallpapers 15
en.tagline: Use Apple wallpapers from multiple iOS releases on the iOS 15 Lock Screen and Home Screen.
description: Download collections from iOS 18, 26 and 27 in Wallpaper Library 15. Selecting a look applies it to both screens.
Includes 42 looks across nine collections. Download each collection on demand.
features: Includes Pride Luminance, Fluidity, Space, Celosia, Flocon, Jurin, Vitra, Marble and Duo.
Space, Celosia, Duo and Fluidity support Automatic, Light and Dark appearances. Automatic follows the system appearance.
Duo offers inner and outer display compositions.
compatibility: Supports iOS 15 with Rootless and RootHide builds.
On iOS 16–18, install StockWallpapers from the same repository.
usage: Follow the package manager's reload prompt. Open Wallpaper Library 15 from the Home Screen or from Settings → StockWallpapers 15.
Download a collection and choose a look. If the stock wallpaper still appears, make sure the jailbreak is active and reload SpringBoard.
Tap System Wallpaper in the library to restore the original wallpaper. The iOS 15 test build can be upgraded in place.

changes: Adds iOS 15 support with 42 downloadable looks across nine collections for the Lock Screen and Home Screen.
Choose Automatic, Light or Dark for supported collections, and inner or outer display composition for Duo.
Fixes flashes of the original wallpaper and incorrect tint when opening or closing Notification Center.
